_comment: English names for everything the player reads out of config/race.json and config/shop.json. Only the words live here: prices, odds, dice faces, blocked spaces and effect ids stay in their own file, written once. src/core/config/i18n.ts lays this over the raw config before it is validated, so a missing entry falls back to the French one rather than breaking the game — config i18n.test.ts is what fails when something is missing. souls and circles are matched by position (same order as race.json), circles[].terrains too; shop items are matched by id, so their order here does not matter.

circles.name: Limbo
circles.power: The ferryman rolls two pairs a turn instead of one.

circles.name: Lust
circles.power: The eternal winds: every -1 becomes -2, for you as for him.

circles.name: Gluttony
circles.power: A rammed soul is bitten: it moves back one space after the jump.

circles.name: Greed
circles.power: Bets placed during the race cost double the stake.

circles.name: Wrath
circles.power: In the Styx, moving back onto a soul pushes it back too instead of swapping.

circles.name: Heresy
circles.power: The betting threshold drops to 40 % of the track.

circles.name: Fraud
circles.power: The Soul dice lie: one time in four they name the neighbouring soul.

circles.name: Treachery
circles.power: He knows your bets: his pairs go for the souls you have bet on first, to push them back.

circles.name: Sea Floor
circles.power: Underwater, every positive distance loses 1: the race runs in slow motion.

circles.name: Cliff
circles.power: A rammed soul is chained: it does not move at all next turn.

circles.name: City
circles.power: He closes one counter a turn: a type of bet becomes unavailable.

circles.name: Mountain
circles.power: The lanes freeze: a soul can no longer pull over, it rams instead.

circles.name: Sky
circles.power: At the end of every turn, all the souls move back one space.

circles.name: Paradise
circles.power: He replays the last turn of the race a second time, opponent included.

lateBet.name: Bettor’s Eye
lateBet.description: Once per circle, place a bet after seeing your dice, before pairing them.

sablier.name: Charon’s Hourglass
sablier.description: The betting threshold goes from 60 % to 70 % of the track, starting this race.

boussole.name: Limbo Compass
boussole.description: After your combinations, the soul of each unused Soul die moves forward 1.

clepsydre.name: Cracked Water Clock
clepsydre.description: On turn 1 of every race, your negative distances turn positive (-1 → +1) and your positive distances gain +1.

ferACheval.name: Rusty Horseshoe
ferACheval.description: The odds on the plain Winner bet are multiplied by 1.5; those on Last place by 0.5.
ferACheval.warning: the odds on Last place are halved

boursePercee.name: Holed Purse
boursePercee.description: Every collision (jump or swap) earns you 2 coins, whether it came from you or the opponent.

livreDesComptes.name: Book of Accounts
livreDesComptes.description: Once per race, one of your losing bets, drawn at random, is refunded at 50 %.

tirelire.name: Intern’s Piggy Bank
tirelire.description: The advance the intern pays you before every race goes up by 10 coins, for the rest of the run.

limbes.name: Limbo Die
limbes.description: Replaces a Distance die with a 1, 1, 2, 2 die: no going back, no great leap.

colere.name: Wrath Die
colere.description: Replaces a Distance die with a -2, 0, 3, 4 die: same average, far more variance.
colere.warning: one face at −2: a two-space step back is possible

glace.name: Ice Die
glace.description: Replaces a Distance die with a -1, -1, 2, 5 die: the die of extremes.
glace.warning: two faces at −1 out of four

prodigalite.name: Prodigality Die
prodigalite.description: Replaces a Distance die with a 2, 3, 3, 4 die. Every pairing of this die costs 3 coins; with no money, it is worth 0.
prodigalite.warning: every pairing costs 3 ¤; with no money, the face is worth 0

decathlon.name: Decathlon Die
decathlon.description: Replaces a Distance die with a ten-faced -3, -2, -1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3 die: the whole range, from a long step back to a long leap, but four faces out of ten go backwards.

limee.name: Filed Face
limee.description: The chosen face is worth 0: the soul is named but does not move. Suggested target: the -1.

doree.name: Gilded Face
doree.description: The chosen face is worth +1 and earns 5 coins every time it comes up. Suggested target: the 1.

retournee.name: Turned Face
retournee.description: The chosen face is worth +1. The catch: the opponent’s -1s are worth +1 too, for the rest of the run. Suggested target: the -1.
retournee.warning: the opponent’s −1s are worth +1 too for the rest of the run

sceau.name: Bettor’s Seal
sceau.description: The chosen face is worth +1, or +3 if the soul moved is one you have a bet on. Suggested target: the 1.

relanceJumelle.name: Twin Reroll
relanceJumelle.description: When two or more Soul dice name the same soul, they are all rerolled once. The second result stands, even if it repeats.

quatriemeTete.name: Cerberus’s Fourth Head
quatriemeTete.description: The roll includes one more Soul die: more choice, and one more unused die.

fioleDeSang.name: Vial of Blood
fioleDeSang.description: Once per turn, pay 5 coins to add +1 to a Distance die before pairing it.
fioleDeSang.warning: every +1 costs 5 ¤ in cash, no credit

verrouDeMinos.name: Minos’s Lock
verrouDeMinos.description: Before each roll, you may lock a Distance die on its face from the previous turn instead of rerolling it.

semellesDePlomb.name: Lead Soles
semellesDePlomb.description: A soul moving back onto a soul in the finishing zone no longer swaps with it: it tucks in just behind.

batDeChameau.name: Camel Pack
batDeChameau.description: Once per race, the first ram fuses the two souls: the rammed one in front, the other behind, and any move of one moves both.
batDeChameau.warning: the fusion lasts the whole race and you only pick it once

balanceTruquee.name: Rigged Scales
balanceTruquee.description: When a soul moves back onto another and swaps places, the swapped soul moves one extra space forward.

chaineDuCoccyte.name: Chain of the Cocytus
chaineDuCoccyte.description: Two souls that have swapped places stay linked until the end of the turn: if one moves, the other follows the same distance.

ticketPremiereHeure.name: First-Hour Ticket
ticketPremiereHeure.description: Bets placed before the first roll pay +1 on the multiplier; those placed during the race pay −0.5, never below ×1.
ticketPremiereHeure.warning: bets placed during the race pay less

quatriemeMarche.name: Fourth Step
quatriemeMarche.description: Your “in the top 3” conditions extend to the top 4. Changes neither “Outside the top 3” nor the Exact podium.

encensoirDuDernier.name: Censer of the Last
encensoirDuDernier.description: The Last place bet pays double if the last soul finishes 5 spaces or more behind the second to last.

pieceADeuxFaces.name: Two-Headed Coin
pieceADeuxFaces.description: After the first roll, you may double the stake on all your open bets. If you do, the opponent rolls one more pair for the rest of the race.
pieceADeuxFaces.warning: the opponent’s turn rolls one more pair until the end of the race

denierDuCercle.name: Penny of the Circle
denierDuCercle.description: Your winning bets are settled as if the stake were n coins higher, n being the circle number. You only pay your own stake.

baumeDuPerdant.name: Loser’s Balm
baumeDuPerdant.description: Every losing stake is returned to you at 10 %. Stacks with the Book of Accounts, which goes first.

tribuneInfernale.name: Infernal Stand
tribuneInfernale.description: Before every race, place a stand on a free space outside the start and outside the finishing zone. Every soul that stops there earns you 4 coins and leaves with a +1 shove.

detteInfernale.name: Infernal Debt
detteInfernale.description: Once per run, if you cannot pay the circle price, borrow what you are short, capped at half the price. The next circle costs 150 % of that sum on top.
detteInfernale.warning: the next circle costs 150 % of the borrowed sum on top

pourboireDuStagiaire.name: Intern’s Tip
pourboireDuStagiaire.description: Right after your first roll of every race, you gain 10 coins.

oeilDeCharon.name: Charon’s Eye
oeilDeCharon.description: You see the opponent’s first pair before ordering your combinations. Does not stack with the Whip or the Mirror.

fouetDuContremaitre.name: Foreman’s Whip
fouetDuContremaitre.description: The opponent rolls all his pairs before your roll; they are resolved after you, as usual.
fouetDuContremaitre.warning: one more opponent pair per turn as soon as a soul is in the finishing zone

miroirDeNarcisse.name: Narcissus’s Mirror
miroirDeNarcisse.description: The opponent plays before you: his pairs are rolled and resolved before your roll. You pair up knowing the board at the end of the turn.
miroirDeNarcisse.warning: the opponent plays before you: he has the last word on nothing, you on everything

marteauHephaistos.name: Hephaestus’s Hammer
marteauHephaistos.description: The first forge alteration of every circle is free; the ones after cost 20 % less.

rabaisDePloutos.name: Plutus’s Discount
rabaisDePloutos.description: Everything the shop sells costs 3 % less, restocking the window included.

fraude.name: Fraud Die
fraude.description: Replaces a Distance die with a 1, 2, 3, ? die — the ? face takes the value of the best other Distance face in the roll.

troisiemeDe.name: Third Distance Die
troisiemeDe.description: Adds a -1, 1, 2, 3 Distance die to the roll: three combinations a turn instead of two.
troisiemeDe.warning: the unused Soul die goes: no more Compass, no more fourth head to feed

explosive.name: Explosive Face
explosive.description: The face is worth +2. If the soul rams on landing, the souls on the neighbouring spaces move back 1; otherwise it is the one that moves back 1.
explosive.warning: with no ram, the soul moves back one space afterwards

bond.name: Leaping Face
bond.description: The soul moves up to the next soul ahead of it and jumps in front. Nobody ahead: it moves forward 3. Never carries it across the line.

miroir.name: Mirror Face
miroir.description: The face copies the value of the other Distance die in the roll, for better or worse.

feuFollet.name: Will-o’-the-Wisp Face
feuFollet.description: When it comes up, the die is rerolled and the new result stands. If the Will-o’-the-Wisp comes up again, it is worth +2.

elan.name: Momentum Face
elan.description: The face is worth +2. You may reroll this die once and add the result, whatever it is.
elan.warning: the reroll is added, even if it comes up −1

gel.name: Freezing Face
gel.description: The face is worth 0 and the named soul is frozen until the end of the turn: the opponent’s pairs do not move it.

aimant.name: Magnet Face
aimant.description: The face is worth +1 and the soul just behind moves forward 1 too, into the space it left.
